title: MP Congress protests in Bhopal over detention of Rahul, Priyanka Gandhi

tea.why: Protesters opposed the detention of Rahul and Priyanka Gandhi in New Delhi and alleged irregularities in electoral rolls.
tea.want: The Congress demanded action on electoral roll allegations, greater transparency from the EC, and the resignation of CEC Gyanesh Kumar.
tea.changed: Oct 7: Madhya Pradesh Congress protested outside the Election Commission's office in Bhopal.

summary: The Madhya Pradesh unit of the Congress staged a protest outside the Election Commission's office in Bhopal on October 7. The demonstration was led by State Congress president Jitu Patwari and Leader of Opposition Umang Singhar, with MLAs, party office-bearers, and workers participating. Former Chief Minister Digvijaya Singh also joined the sit-in. Protesters raised slogans against the Election Commission and burnt an effigy of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. The protest was held against the detention of Rahul Gandhi and Priyanka Gandhi Vadra in New Delhi during an opposition demonstration concerning alleged irregularities in electoral rolls. Organizers stated the protest aimed to defend democratic rights and the impartiality of constitutional institutions, demanding action on electoral roll allegations and the resignation of CEC Gyanesh Kumar.
organizers: Madhya Pradesh unit of the Congress
demands: Action on allegations of irregularities in electoral rolls
Greater transparency from the Election Commission
Resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar
Defend democratic rights and impartiality of constitutional institutions
response: No official response reported in the sources.

updates.text: The Madhya Pradesh Congress protested outside the Election Commission's office in Bhopal, led by Jitu Patwari and Umang Singhar. (1, 2)
Protesters raised slogans against the Election Commission and burnt an effigy of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. (1, 2)
State Congress president Jitu Patwari stated the protest aimed to defend democratic rights and institutional impartiality. (1)
LoP Umang Singhar said the demonstration was against the detention of Rahul Gandhi and Priyanka Gandhi Vadra in New Delhi. (1, 2)
Jitu Patwari announced that the party would continue its agitation until CEC Gyanesh Kumar resigns and would burn effigies in every district. (2)
